description: The file defines a mock class 'MockSearch' for testing purposes, which extends the 'SearchEngine' class from SuiteCRM. It implements two methods: 'search' returning simulated search results based on input, and 'searchAndDisplay' outputting total search results.

classes.name: MockSearch
classes.description: A mock implementation of a search engine for testing, extending SuiteCRM's SearchEngine.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a simulated search, returning results based on whether the search string equals 'bar'.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Outputs the total number of search results.
